## 2024-05-18 - Prevent XSS in HTML-generating Prompt Engineering

**Vulnerability:** XSS vulnerability where an LLM could generate HTML cards containing unsanitized context input from the user session.
**Learning:** In prompt-based applications where the UI is generated by the LLM, XSS rules still apply. Input data must be escaped before being rendered into the resulting HTML output.
**Prevention:** Include a strict instruction directly in the prompt specification to enforce the escaping of HTML entities (`<`, `>`, `&`, `"`, `'`) for all context variables embedded in the HTML.
